prompt:
Translate the entire Swedish product description into English. If a blank line introduces an Additional glossary section, use that section as terminology data, not as text to translate. Apply both glossaries by the same rules.

Use the required English wording for each applicable Swedish term, including inflections, compound uses, and list entries. Keep the required wording as a distinct word or phrase in compounds; use ordinary English plurals or possessives as needed. Translate each occurrence explicitly, including repeats. Do not use either forbidden alternative for an applicable entry anywhere in the translation.

Return only the translation in plain text. Keep brand and product names verbatim, preserve paragraphs and inline lists, and omit no source information. No Markdown, headings, bullets, numbered lists, introduction, closing remark, or notes. Aim for about 1.15 English words per Swedish source word.

GLOSSARY (Swedish -> required English; forbidden alternatives in parentheses):
- laddare -> charger (adapter, power supply)
- batteri -> battery (accumulator, power cell)
- skärm -> display (screen, panel)
- fodral -> case (pouch, sleeve)
- sladd -> cord (wire, flex)
- kontakt -> plug (connector, socket)
- strömbrytare -> power switch (on/off switch, toggle)
- knapp -> button (knob, toggle)
- hölje -> housing (casing, enclosure)
- lock -> lid (cap, hatch)
- fäste -> mount (bracket, holder)
- reglage -> control (slider, dial)
- sil -> strainer (sieve, colander)
- behållare -> container (tank, reservoir)
- munstycke -> nozzle (spout, jet)
- slang -> hose (tube, pipe)
- handtag -> handle (grip, hilt)
- givare -> sensor (detector, probe)
- mätare -> gauge (indicator, readout)
- vattentät -> waterproof (water-resistant, watertight)
- tålig -> durable (robust, sturdy)
- slitstark -> hard-wearing (wear-resistant, long-lasting)
- trådlös -> wireless (cordless, cable-free)
- uppladdningsbar -> rechargeable (chargeable, reusable)
- inställning -> setting (configuration, preset)
- läge -> mode (position, program)
- tillbehör -> accessory (add-on, attachment)
- reservdel -> spare part (replacement part, component)
- garanti -> warranty (guarantee, guaranty)
- bruksanvisning -> user manual (instructions, guide)
- leverans -> delivery (shipment, shipping)
- förpackning -> packaging (package, box)
- vikt -> weight (mass, heft)
- mått -> dimensions (measurements, proportions)
- motor -> motor (engine, drive unit)
- fläkt -> fan (blower, ventilator)
- lampa -> lamp (bulb, luminaire)
- ljusstyrka -> brightness (luminosity, luminance)
- upplösning -> resolution (definition, sharpness)
- anslutning -> connection (port, interface)
